impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while if self.enabled_for_the_current_block {
            self.control_lane_consumer_for_this_strip.has_records()
        } else {
            false
        } {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
